summary: @or-sdk/pgsql preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall lifecycle hook that runs setup.mjs, an obfuscator.io-style script using hex identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x19328d`) and string-dictionary lookups to hide constants like command names, file paths, and `/etc/os-release`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it via execFileSync to run a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line, heavily obfuscated JavaScript bundle (shuffled string-array constructor with ~1000 tokens, hex-suffixed globals). Neither Bun nor the math_init.js payload is related to the package's stated purpose as a PostgreSQL SDK. The alternate-runtime execution pattern evades Node-based tooling and inspection, and the obfuscated payload runs with the installer's privileges on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
